definition.prompt:
make a raving 8bit johnny bravo

Generate a native animated GIF of the character dancing in a seamless loop. Use the latest GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst native GIF capability if available. Requested delivery: output_format gif, 9 frames, 200 milliseconds per frame. Return the finished multi-frame GIF file directly. Do not return a sprite sheet or storyboard; do not provide code or compose frames locally.

review.notes: Explicit GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst native GIF request in prompt returned a single PNG containing nine storyboard panels. No model selection parameter was available, so actual model version remains unknown. No native GIF attachment, composition or publication.
